# McCaigs Group owners of the registered trade mark for "McCaigs".

> McCaigs Group is a Scottish technology group headquartered in Edinburgh, Scotland. It builds practical AI systems, deterministic assistants, automation platforms, modern websites, internal tools, and digital products through its specialist technical studio, McCaigs.

McCaigs Group focuses on useful, production-ready systems rather than AI theatre. The group builds deterministic and structured software where reliability matters, and uses AI only where it adds clear value.

## Identity

- [McCaigs Group](https://www.mccaigs.com/): Scottish technology group headquartered in Edinburgh, Scotland.
- [McCaigs](https://www.mccaigs.com/studio): Specialist technical studio within McCaigs Group.
- [About McCaigs](https://www.mccaigs.com/about): Background on the group, studio, positioning, and approach.

McCaigs Group is unrelated to McCaig's Tower, McCaig's Warehouse, or other places and landmarks in Oban, Scotland. However it does own the rights to the trade mark "McCaigs".
